# GammaRips

> The options-flow data layer for AI agents. Stop asking AI for stock picks. Give it real data.

GammaRips is an options-flow intelligence engine and data vendor. Every trading night it ranks about 3,500 optionable US stocks by liquidity, keeps the top 100, and prices one out-of-the-money call in each bullish name: a pool of roughly 40 to 50 contracts an agent can actually trade. Liquidity decides membership, not unusual activity. Humans browse everything free at gammarips.com; AI agents connect over MCP (paid, $29/mo founding price, 30-day free trial) for the structured data layer: the pool, point-in-time feature vectors, opportunity surfaces (realized peak/drawdown excursions per historical contract), a queryable outcome database, exit-rule simulation, regime context, and methodology playbooks.

There is no pick endpoint, deliberately. GammaRips sells the data a decision comes from, not the decision. Each user's agent reasons over the same data to its own conclusion, including via the published bracket-tournament selection playbook, run against the user's own objective. Honest baselines, published openly: buying the whole pool mechanically under a fixed exit is negative, and two pre-registered studies (August 2026) could not distinguish the pool from matched random optionable contracts. What the liquidity rule measurably improves is executability (study window, 60 trading days ending 2026-08-14: no-fill at 10:00 ET fell from 40.5% to 6.1%). The value is a fillable pool + history + your agent's analysis.

Data on a paper-trading basis, educational only. Not investment advice.

## The funnel (V7.1, liquidity-first since 2026-08-24)

1. **Scanner**: nightly liquidity rank of about 3,500 optionable US stocks. A name needs 3M+ session share volume and 25+ listed strikes; the top 100 by combined chain dollar volume and share volume survive. Liquidity decides membership, not unusual activity; flow is context in the data, not a gate.
2. **Pool**: bullish names only; one out-of-the-money call per name, chosen on contract liquidity; roughly 40 to 50 contracts (`overnight_score >= 1` is a cosmetic floor; most days more than 50 bullish names qualify, and a deterministic point-in-time rank (delta band, 60-day momentum, a liquidity demotion) keeps 50, using no outcome data). Thesis, technicals, news context, and the selected contract attached per name.
3. **Safety rails (cohort entry, not pool membership)**: before its paper entry the validation cohort drops names with earnings in the hold window and stands down when VIX > VIX3M. The published pool is NOT earnings-screened; run `get_signal` with `view=earnings` on any candidate before acting.
4. **Leakage discipline**: every field is point-in-time; nothing an agent reads contains information that wasn't knowable at the time it's dated.
5. **Validation & tracking**: every pool candidate is tracked to its realized outcome and published as distributions (Track Record); a small paper-traded cohort additionally exercises the methodology daily under fixed rules, privately, with no stats marketed pre-30 trades.

## MCP server (Agent Access: API key or OAuth sign-in)

- Endpoint: `https://mcp.gammarips.com/mcp`
- Transport: Streamable HTTP (legacy SSE at `/sse`)
- Auth, option 1 (any client that can send a header): `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`, generated by the subscriber at https://gammarips.com/account with an active subscription (subscribe at https://gammarips.com/pricing; $29/mo, 30-day free trial; the key is shown once, at creation)
- Auth, option 2 (chat clients that cannot send a header): OAuth 2.1 at `https://mcp.gammarips.com/pro`, the credentialed twin of `/mcp` with the same transport and the same 9 tools. An anonymous request gets a 401 naming the authorization server (`https://gammarips.com`), which starts the sign-in. PKCE S256 required; dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) and client ID metadata documents both supported; grants `authorization_code`, `refresh_token`, `client_credentials`; scope `mcp:read`. Discovery: `https://mcp.gammarips.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/pro` and `https://gammarips.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`. Headless agents use `client_credentials` with a machine client created at https://gammarips.com/account. An API key also works on `/pro`; `/mcp` stays anonymous.
- Anonymous funnel tier (no key): the pool preview (`get_pool` with `view=preview`), daily reports, methodology playbooks, and the regime and calendar reference tools. The full pool and the outcome substrate require a key.
- Start with: `get_pool`, `query_outcomes`, `get_playbook`
- All 9 tools: `get_pool` (the candidate pool; `view=preview` is free, `view=enriched`/`raw`/`features` need a pro key), `get_signal` (one ticker: detail or earnings-window check), `get_liquidity` (fresh entry-day liquidity, one contract or the whole pool), `query_outcomes` (realized outcomes and receipts, nine views), `replay_contract` (raw option price tape, minute or daily), `get_regime_context` (VIX vs VIX3M regime rail), `get_market_calendar_status` (NYSE status or available scan dates), `get_playbook` (methodology, field dictionary, and data-contract schema), `get_daily_report` (the daily report or a list of recent ones)
- Built-in prompts: `morning_brief`, `analyze_candidate`, `run_your_own_tournament`: workflows that end in a decision surface, never a pick.

## Pricing

- **Free**: the whole human-readable website. Today's pool, daily reports, per-ticker deep dives, scorecard, the Lab, methodology. Free forever, no account required.
- **Agent Access $29/mo**: full MCP access. $29/mo is the founding price, for the first 100 subscribers, and it stays at that rate as long as the subscription stays active. The price is $39/mo after that. Send your API key in an Authorization header (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and any MCP client that can send the header), or add `https://mcp.gammarips.com/pro` and sign in with OAuth, which is how a chat client that cannot send a header reaches the same tools. The free tier works in every MCP client with no credential at all. 30-day free trial. Cancel anytime.
